body.x: INNOWORKS(representative Seon-yeong Han, www.icover.kr) has been showing varied mobile accessories at CES 2012 (Consumer Electronics Show 2012) held in Las Vegas, US from Jan 10 to 13 (local time).(Picture 1: 'iDin' iPhone case which can storage credit card and transportation card conveniently)INNOWORKS has been exhibiting three kinds of cases, 'iDin series' card built -in type iPhoned case, 'Forte' iPhoned case composed of silicon materials on the inside and premium polycarbonate material on the outside of the case, and 'CARBIO series' Galaxy tab 10.1 inch made with leather.'iDin Case', can storage the credit card and transportation card simply, and it's a follow up model of iPhone 3G card storage case. Card storage is convenient and easy also it has wonderful sliding feeling for card. In addition, this case can reduce risk of loss of transportation card as well as improve convenience.'Forte' is suitable for young people who enjoy extreme sports and have many active mass because it has powerful function of impact absorption , also it can be changed as user's individual style with extra clips.'CARBIO series' for Galaxy tab 10.1 inch can be stood as user's convenient by folding the front case. It's especially useful when user reads books or watches TV.iCover series made a splendid achievement of 1000% sales increase in 2011 in overseas market with high-quality and classy design in four years, since 2007 established.

They made a patent license contract with 'Keith Haring' a pop artist of America, and 'Infinite Challenge' the most famous variety program in Korea, and they are rapidly increasing market share of on-line and off-line in Korea.

Meanwhile, Incheon IT Promotion Agency(IITPA, Director Sung-kap Cho, www.iitpa.or.kr) have prepared exhaustively from prior meeting to on-the-site marketing including finding buyers, market research and others for CES held in Las vegas, US.
